title: fix(service-settings,platform-objects): Branding's name is the product name with no unserved default, and both timezone fields say which one is in effect
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuA2jsB5ocLSV8XnUmaYAnbA)_

Part of #25347

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim of record: `6367274301` on the card (card thread, `domain:services` seat 1). Branch `claude/project-thread-xvfy21` is the harness-pinned branch for this session. It names no issue, so the Duplicate Fix Guard's branch-name hint will not match, and the claim is the identity record.

**Part of, not Fixes:** the card's "the organization's display name is edited in one place" is not met under `single` by this PR. Under `single` the organization cannot be renamed at all: both rename actions are gated on `multiOrgEnabled`, and the generic edit form keeps `name` readonly. The claim proposed gating `rename_organization` on the `organization` capability. That gate is booked in `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts` (`PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs`), which platform-objects' `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` checks in both directions, so the spec line and the object change must land in one PR. The spec lane is not this card thread's, so that half is held back and handed to the coordinator. The card stays open for it.

## What each surface reads (measured on `b9c7a8f5`)

| Surface | Reads | Unsaved deployment shows |
|---|---|---|
| Console chrome, sign-in page, browser title | `runtime/config` `branding.productName`: a SAVED `branding.workspace_name` under `single`, else the host option, `OS_PRODUCT_NAME`, `'ObjectOS'` | ObjectOS |
| Auth mail, authenticator issuer, MCP sign-in | a SAVED `branding.workspace_name`, else `appName` (`OS_APP_NAME`), `'ObjectStack'` | ObjectStack |
| Settings → Branding "Organization name" | `workspace_name`, manifest default `'ObjectStack'`, served by neither reader | ObjectStack |
| Organization record and switcher | `sys_organization.name` | Default Organization |
| Formulas, report date buckets, rendered instants, the console's first-run prompt | `localization.timezone` (tenant scope, one row per organization) via `resolveLocalizationContext` | UTC |
| Organization record "Timezone" | `sys_organization.timezone`: zero readers in this repository | (unset) |

## What changes

**`@objectstack/service-settings`**
- `branding.workspace_name` is labelled **"Product name"**, not "Organization name", in the manifest and in all four bundles. It names the product the deployment shows. Its help adds: "Leave empty to use the name this deployment was set up with. This is not the organization's own name, which is the Name on the Organization record."
- Its `'ObjectStack'` default is dropped, and `required` becomes `false`, as `accent_color` already is. The default was a third name that no reader served. An unsaved page now shows the field empty, and `GET /api/settings/branding` answers `value: null` with `source: 'default'`.
  - `required: false` follows from dropping the default. Without it, objectui's pre-save check blocks every save of the page until a name is typed.
  - This is the widening: an empty value is now accepted. Both readers already treat an empty value as unset (`readSavedBranding` drops `''`; `setAppName` trims to `undefined`), so nothing served changes.
- `localization.timezone`'s help adds: "This is the timezone in effect for the organization: the Timezone field on the Organization record does not change it." Manifest plus all four bundles.

**`@objectstack/platform-objects`**
- `sys_organization.name` gets help: "The organization's own name. The product name the console shows is a different setting, set in Settings → Branding." It names no door, because the rename doors are multi-org only.
- `sys_organization.timezone`'s help no longer says date boundaries are computed in it, because no reader backs that claim (Prime Directive #10). It now says the value is kept as the root default for business units, changes no date calculation today, and that formulas, reports and displayed dates use Settings → Localization → Default timezone.
- `en.objects.generated.ts` was regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. The `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` leaves were translated by hand.

No stored value changes meaning, and no write is newly refused.

## Pins

- `branding.manifest.test.ts`: three new cases. `workspace_name` declares no default (source and parsed), is not required, and is labelled "Product name" with help pointing at the Organization record.
- `localization.manifest.test.ts`: one new case. The timezone help names itself the zone in effect and says the organization record's field does not change it.
- New `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization-name-timezone-help.test.ts`, two cases: the name help points at Branding, and the timezone help says it changes no date calculation, names Localization's Default timezone, and no longer says "are computed in".
- `settings-service.test.ts`: two moved pins. "returns default when nothing set" now reads `localization.timezone` (`'UTC'`) to keep a non-null default covered. A new case pins `workspace_name`'s `null` default. The reset case expects `null`.

**Ablation:** with `branding.manifest.ts` and `sys-organization.object.ts` restored from `b9c7a8f5` (worktree only), `branding.manifest.test.ts` had 3 failed and 5 passed, and `sys-organization-name-timezone-help.test.ts` had 2 failed. With `localization.manifest.ts` restored, `localization.manifest.test.ts` had 1 failed and 7 passed. After restoring HEAD, all passed and `git diff --quiet HEAD` was clean.

## Tests and gates

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test`: `Test Files 59 passed (59)`, `Tests 993 passed (993)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: `Test Files 94 passed (94)`, `Tests 1343 passed (1343)`.
- Both package `typecheck` scripts: exit 0.
- Both suites and `check-i18n-bundles` re-ran green after `main` was merged in (`9177cf7b`). The 8 incoming commits touch other `platform-objects` bundles (`*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`).
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 68 families. All 68 exited 0, and `--ran` reports 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two of them first exited 3 on missing prerequisites and were rerun after the fix:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: fetched its pinned fixture commit;
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: built the 7 dists it named.
- `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (no breaking changeset) and eslint on the changed files all passed.
- Full dogfood battery: not owed. The title has no `!` and `Clause-②` carries no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Out of scope (for the seat)

- **The rename door under `single`** needs the spec registry line. It is handed to the coordinator, the card stays open, and the declaration, pins and a dogfood runtime pin for a `single` boot are written and kept ready.
- **Two built-in product names:** with neither env var set, the chrome says `ObjectOS` (`OS_PRODUCT_NAME`, `cloud-connection`, cli lane) and auth mail says `ObjectStack` (`OS_APP_NAME`, `plugin-auth`). Acceptance notes.
- **`sys_business_unit.timezone`'s help** still promises inheritance from the parent unit and the organization, which no reader implements. That is a documented contract by ruling, not a mechanism. Acceptance notes.

Changesets: `.changeset/25347-branding-product-name.md` (`@objectstack/service-settings` patch) and `.changeset/25347-organization-name-timezone-help.md` (`@objectstack/platform-objects` patch, `Clause-②: no`).
